# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 004, Serye ng 2018 (Kapasiyahan Blg. 106) — Designated Smoking Areas

## Summary

This ordinance, approved as Kapasiyahan Blg. 106, establishes designated smoking areas within the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]]. Motioned by [[Konsehal Esperanza A. Tan]] with [[Konsehal Carlos T. Gliane II]] and [[Konsehal Adam M. Forbes]], the ordinance cites [[RA 8749]] (Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999) on the right to breathe clean air and [[RA 9211]] (Tobacco Regulation Act of 2003) which prohibits smoking in public places and regulates the sale of tobacco products to minors. The ordinance defines specific locations as designated smoking areas and prohibits smoking outside these areas.

## Key Provisions

- Section 1 establishes the legal basis citing [[RA 8749]] and [[RA 9211]].
- Section 2 onwards defines designated smoking areas within the municipality.
- Prohibits smoking in public places outside the designated smoking areas.
- References [[RA 8749]] (Clean Air Act) on the right to breathe clean air.
- References [[RA 9211]] (Tobacco Regulation Act) on prohibiting smoking in public places and regulating sale of tobacco to minors.
- Exercises the general welfare power under [[Sec-16-RA7160]] to promote public health.

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General Welfare Clause.
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, and functions of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- [[RA 8749]] — Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999; right to breathe clean air.
- [[RA 9211]] — Tobacco Regulation Act of 2003; prohibits smoking in public places, regulates sale to minors.
